items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Yes, I did a lot of things with her and played for her a lot.

ctx.x: stuff. She was just improvising. She's a beautiful, beautiful, beautiful woman.
Yes, I did a lot of things with her and played for her a lot. I played for Carmen quite a bit, but it wasn't like playing for Sarah. There's nothing like playing for Sarah or Lady Day.

When I used to work for Lady Day, it was like... I was a lot younger, you know, of course... It was like I couldn't wait to get there. I just couldn't wait to get there and see her and Pepe, her little dog. I'd go all the way up to his ears, and then he'd start snapping his teeth and I'd quit. Because he'd turn around and bite your hand if you went past his ears.
